equipment.name: Silas Radix Heart, Liver, Brain, Pancreas, Esophagus, Tongue, Foot, Hand, Small Intestine, Large Intestine (1 ea)
Fish Eggs (Stored inside stomach of Silent Radix)
Skeleton of Rat missing both femurs
Bedroll
equipment.desc: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see the Dungeon Master's Guide).

equipment.name: Backpack
equipment.desc: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.

equipment.name: Caltrops
equipment.desc: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.

equipment.name: Crowbar
equipment.desc: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

equipment.name: Oil
equipment.desc: You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below. Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra 5 Fire damage from burning oil. Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an O

equipment.name: Rations
equipment.desc: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See "Malnutrition" for the risks of not eating.

equipment.name: Rope
equipment.desc: As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

equipment.name: Tinderbox
equipment.desc: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

equipment.name: Torch
equipment.desc: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.

equipment.name: Clothing, cold weather
equipment.desc: This outfit consists of a heavy fur coat or cloak over layers of wool clothing, as well as a fur-lined hat or hood, goggles, and fur-lined leather boots and gloves. As long as cold weather clothing remains dry, its wearer automatically succeeds on saving throws against the effects of extreme cold.

equipment.name: Waterskin
equipment.desc: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.

equipment.name: Iron
equipment.desc: Trade Good. Merchants commonly exchange trade goods without using currency.

equipment.name: Wand
equipment.desc: An Arcane Focus takes a specific form and is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

equipment.name: Hunting Trap
equipment.desc: As a Utilize action, you can set a Hunting Trap, which is a sawtooth steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to m

equipment.name: Ball Bearings
equipment.desc: As a Utilize action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.

magicItems.name: Hat of the Sanguine Coven
magicItems.desc:
This red hat is worn by a coven of witches known for their familiarity with death's doorstep. While wearing this hat, you can cast the *chill touch* spell at will. Whenever you have 0 hit points while wearing this hat, you gain the following benefits:

- You stabilize or die after your sixth successful or failed death saving throw, instead of your third, but only succeed on the saving throw on a roll of 15 or higher.
- When you roll a death saving throw, you can immediately cause the hat to cast the *chill touch* spell (+5 to hit, no action required) against a creature within 30 feet of you that isn't behind total cover or heavily obscured. If it hits, you gain a +5 bonus to the saving throw.

magicItems.name: Candle of the Deep
magicItems.desc: The flame of this candle isn’t extinguished when immersed in water. It gives off light and heat like a normal candle.
magicItems._baseDesc: The flame of this candle isn’t extinguished when immersed in water. It gives off light and heat like a normal candle.

magicItems.name: Amulet of Health
magicItems.desc: My Constitution score is 19 while I'm wearing this amulet, provided that my Constitution is not already 19 or higher.
magicItems._baseDesc: My Constitution score is 19 while I'm wearing this amulet, provided that my Constitution is not already 19 or higher.

magicItems.name: Magebane Bolas
magicItems.desc: You can make a ranged weapon attack with these bolas against a Large or smaller target. When you do, you throw the bolas at the target; on a hit, the target takes the *1d4 bludgeoning* damage, and it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (*DC = 8 + Dex + Prof*) or be knocked prone and entangled by the bolas. If the target has the ability to cast spells, they subtract *1d6* from this save and future saves made attempting to escape the bolas. While entangled in this way, the target's has the *restrained* condition, and is unable to speak. The target remains entangled until it's freed. A creature can use its action to make a *DC = (8 + Int + Prof)* Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within reach on a success. If the target has the *Spellcasting* or *Pact-Magic* feature, the *DC* becomes (*10 + Int + Prof*).

magicItems.name: Potion of Resistance
magicItems.desc: When you drink this potion, you have Resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.
magicItems._baseDesc: When you drink this potion, you have Resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

magicItems.name: Delerium Crystal (Shard)
magicItems.desc: Market value 500 gp; AC 19, HP 15 (as an object); extraction time 5 minutes. A raw deposit of crystallized delerium, embedded in Contaminated flesh or environment — must be carefully extracted before it shatters.
magicItems._baseDesc: Market value 500 gp; AC 19, HP 15 (as an object); extraction time 5 minutes. A raw deposit of crystallized delerium, embedded in Contaminated flesh or environment — must be carefully extracted before it shatters.

magicItems.name: Amulet of the Watcher
magicItems.desc:
Gain +1 to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your spells.
Gain proficiency in perception. If you already have proficiency, gain expertise instead.

Additionally, as an action, you can place up to two spectral eyes (only visible with a DC20 Perception or DC15 Arcana check) firmly on a solid surface—such as a wall, table, or boot—where it remains until destroyed. While you're within 5 feet of an eye, you can use a bonus action to speak the command word to cause its eye to open. The opening is about the size of a keyhole, and by peering through it, you can open and see through another eye's opening of your choice. You choose which eye to look through the first time you peer into the hole and can change it again using a bonus action. If another eye is placed when two are already active, the eye that was placed *first* disappears in a non-harmful yet visible & audible explosion of blue light.

The eyes you can choose to see through in this way must be a part of the set, be placed on a solid surface, and be on the same plane of existence as the one you're looking through. You can only see through one eye at a time, which operates both ways, and nothing can pass through the hole. If another eye attempts to look through one you're already using, the connection between the first two ends and is replaced by the new one. An eye closes when it's no longer being looked through.

Each eye has AC 10 and 5 hit points. If it drops to 0 hit points, the eye is destroyed. If a target or area is immune to divination magic or can't be perceived through scrying sensors, it doesn't appear through the hole.

Third Eye. When you make a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check involving sight, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

Primeval Awakening:
The Amulet has 10 charges, and regains 1d4 daily at Dawn. You can cast the following spells using the amulets charges:
Darkvision: 2 Charges
See Invisibility: 2 Charges
Arcane Eye: 5 Charges
True Seeing: 10 Charges
Eyebite: 10 Charges

magicItems.name: Bag of Holding
magicItems.desc: This bag is 2 ft in diameter at the mouth, 4 ft deep, and 5 lb regardless of content. It can hold up to 500 lb, not exceeding a volume of 64 cu ft. Retrieving an item from it requires an action. If it's overloaded, pierced, or torn, it's destroyed with its contents in the Astral plane. If turned inside out, all its contents spill forth.

magicItems.name: Carpet of Flying, 5 ft. × 7 ft.
magicItems.desc:
You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

A 5 ft. × 7 ft. carpet can carry up to 600 lb. at a fly speed of 40 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

magicItems.name: Aboleth Brain
magicItems.desc:
*The Brain of a young Aboleth, tainted by an otherwordly power.* The brain can be consumed, granting the following bonuses:

Otherwordly Memories
Your mind becomes flooded with cosmic memories that aren't your own. Once per day, you may attempt to call upon these memories to try and glean some information about a particular item, place, creature or course of action by making a Wisdom saving throw.

On a 20+, you may ask the DM one question, and receive a vague but truthful answer, provided the answer is within these memories. If it is not, the daily use of this feature is not consumed.

On a 15-19, you may ask the DM one question, and receive a vision associated with the question asked, provided the answer is within these memories.

On a 14 or lower, you take 3d8 psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute, as your mind is flooded with incomprehensible thoughts.

Improved Mutations
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with your organic weapons.

Devouring Urge
Once per turn when you hit a creature with your organic weapon, you can deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic or Psychic damage (your choice) to the creature, and you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice to roll it and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point). You can only use this feature once per turn. In addition, the flesh consumed by the creature temporarily alters your form. The DM will either:

Grant you a temporary mutation of the DM's choice, which last for 1 minute. Using this feature again on a different creature will replace an existing mutation with the newest one.

Roll a d100. You gain a random mutation from the Mutations Table, which lasts for 1 minute. Using this feature again on a different creature will replace any existing mutation/s with the newest one/s.

customResources.name: Heroic Inspiration
customResources.desc: Reroll a d20 after seeing the result, before the DM says whether it succeeds. Granted situationally by the DM - starts unavailable until they grant it; reset it yourself when you gain or spend it.
